lemon noun

Traupman
M-O

citreum, citreī n.

noun, second declension

lemon in modern use

Ancient uses commonly referred to the citron. Traupman records citreum for lemon. Morgan–Owens distinguishes its ancient citron reference from the later lemon use.

Examples

  • sūcus citreī

    lemon juicecomposed

See also lemon tree.

SourcesMorgan–Owens, Adumbratio: numbered food and kitchen sections · Lewis & Short: citreum
